useDirection

This hook helps to handles direction state of the app.

Example
import useDirection from '@/utils/hooks/useDirection'

const Component = () => {

	const [direction, updateDirection] = useDirection()

	const handleDirChange = () => {
		updateDirection('rtl')
	}

	return (...)
}

RETURN	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
direction	Current direction state	'ltr' | 'rtl'	-
updateDirection	Direction setter	(direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl') => void	-
